name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Dasari goes with none of Geologist, Navigator, or 7 ly.
Between Dasari and Eklund, one goes with Geologist and the other with Medic.
Exactly one of these is true: Dasari goes with 6 ly; Eklund goes with Medic; Geologist goes with 8 ly.
